meta.source: GitLama Meridian 3.0 — docs/design-system/tokens/gitlama-tokens.json is the single token source
meta.themes: light is the first theme; a token without a dark value inherits light

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The window canvas behind the islands; also the sidebar's surface. Nothing but the sidebar, toolbar and repo tabs sit directly on it.

tokens.name: ground-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for sidebar rows, toolbar buttons and tabs that sit on `ground`.

tokens.name: pane
tokens.usage: Island surface: History, Changes, Detail, Diff. The default reading surface.

tokens.name: pane-alt
tokens.usage: Inset areas inside an island: the commit Composer, file-list headers, the hunk header strip, zebra rows in dense tables.

tokens.name: pane-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows and quiet controls inside an island.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the Logbook, dialogs and the Compass palette. Always paired with `shadow-float`.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modal dialogs only (never behind popovers).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `ground`, `raised` and `polar-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: authors, dates, counts, captions, section headers, idle icons. Reads on `pane`, `pane-alt`, `ground` and `polar-soft` (≥5:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, placeholders and the graph's distant lanes when a lane is focused. Never for text a person must read (≈3:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers inside islands, list separators, island edge (with `shadow-pane`). Decorative, not a boundary that carries meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Button outlines and the splitter grip — controls that also carry a text label or icon.

tokens.name: control-edge
tokens.usage: Boundary of text fields, checkboxes, switches and the segmented track (3:1 on `pane` and `raised`).

tokens.name: polar
tokens.usage: The one accent: cerulean, the icon's ground (Meridian `accent`; `polar` is GitLama's historical reference name). Primary button fill, selected row in the focused island, focus ring, active tab underline, progress.

tokens.name: on-polar
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `polar` fills.

tokens.name: on-polar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (author, date, hash) inside a `polar`-filled selected row.

tokens.name: polar-soft
tokens.usage: Selection in an island that does not have focus; the active sidebar row; tinted local-branch chips. Ink and `polar-ink` read on it.

tokens.name: polar-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-colored text: links, the Compass branch name, local ref labels on `polar-soft` and `pane`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 1px, on every focusable control. ≥3:1 on `pane`, `ground` and `raised` in both themes.

tokens.name: added
tokens.usage: Added lines' gutter sign, the A status glyph, +N counts. Text on `pane` and `added-bg`.

tokens.name: added-bg
tokens.usage: Background of added diff lines.

tokens.name: added-strong
tokens.usage: Intraline highlight of the changed words inside an added line (ink on it).

tokens.name: deleted
tokens.usage: Removed lines' gutter sign, the D status glyph, −N counts. Text on `pane` and `deleted-bg`.

tokens.name: deleted-bg
tokens.usage: Background of removed diff lines.

tokens.name: deleted-strong
tokens.usage: Intraline highlight inside a removed line (ink on it).

tokens.name: modified
tokens.usage: The M status glyph, dirty-worktree dot, warnings. Text on `pane` and `modified-bg`.

tokens.name: modified-bg
tokens.usage: Warning banner and Logbook warning row background.

tokens.name: renamed
tokens.usage: The R / C status glyphs (renamed, copied).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (Discard, Delete branch, Force push), error text and error icons on `pane` and `raised`.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Error banner and failed Logbook row background.

tokens.name: conflict
tokens.usage: Conflict glyph (!), unresolved-count badge, conflict region rails. Orange, not red: a conflict is work to do, not a failure.

tokens.name: conflict-bg
tokens.usage: Background of unresolved conflict regions.

tokens.name: side-ours
tokens.usage: Rail and label of the current (ours) side in the Conflict resolver.

tokens.name: side-theirs
tokens.usage: Rail and label of the incoming (theirs) side in the Conflict resolver.

tokens.name: tag-ink
tokens.usage: Tag chip label and notch.

tokens.name: tag-bg
tokens.usage: Tag chip fill.

tokens.name: fjord
tokens.usage: Brand only: the slate brand ground (Meridian `brand`). Welcome screen hero, About box and the cover. Never a UI surface.

tokens.name: lane-1
tokens.usage: Graph lane 1 (blue — the first-parent lane of HEAD's branch): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-2
tokens.usage: Graph lane 2 (teal): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-3
tokens.usage: Graph lane 3 (amber): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-4
tokens.usage: Graph lane 4 (orange): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-5
tokens.usage: Graph lane 5 (rose): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-6
tokens.usage: Graph lane 6 (violet): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-7
tokens.usage: Graph lane 7 (cyan): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

tokens.name: lane-8
tokens.usage: Graph lane 8 (olive): the lane stroke, its node ring and the dot on ref chips that sit on it. ≥4:1 on `pane` both themes.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI", Cantarell, "Noto Sans", sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Welcome screen and empty-state headline only. One per window.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles; Settings page titles.

styles.name: subject
styles.sample: Preserve Windows soak failures through process cleanup
styles.usage: The commit subject at the top of the Detail island.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Recover Windows named pipe after early client disconnect
styles.usage: Default for rows (commit subjects, file names, sidebar items), fields and menus.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: The checked-out branch in the sidebar, the Compass repo name, emphasised row text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, segmented options, chips, tab labels, settings labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Toolbar button labels, metadata lines, counts, the status bar.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar and palette section headers, set in capitals, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Diff, blame, file content and Logbook command output.

styles.name: hash
styles.usage: Commit hashes, line numbers, git command lines. Always `ink-muted` unless selected.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudges; the gap inside the tracking-pair chip.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label in chips and toolbar buttons; ref chip padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between island edges and the ground (the gutter); row inset from island edge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default control padding-x, gap between related controls, row padding-x.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Island header padding-x; gap between control groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Popover and Logbook padding; Detail island content inset.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; settings row spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Dialog section gaps; welcome screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Status glyph tiles, Kbd keys, the diff intraline highlight.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Rows (selection is an inset rounded bar, not a full-bleed stripe), ref chips, sidebar items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented track, repo tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Islands (History, Changes, Detail) and banners.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Popovers, the Logbook, dialogs, the Compass palette.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: The Compass bar, count badges, switches, progress bars.

tokens.name: shadow-pane
tokens.usage: Every island. It is the island's edge — islands have no separate border.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popovers, menus, the Logbook, the Compass palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons and the selected segmented option — a 1px lip, never a blur.

tokens.name: size-row-compact
tokens.usage: Row height at Compact density.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Row height at Regular density (default) — commit rows, file rows, sidebar rows.

tokens.name: size-row-comfortable
tokens.usage: Row height at Comfortable density.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, segmented controls, select.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Controls inside island headers and rows (hover actions, filters).

tokens.name: size-toolbar
tokens.usage: Unified title bar + toolbar height.

tokens.name: size-tabbar
tokens.usage: Repository tab strip.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar width (resizable 200–360).

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: All UI icons; 14px inside chips and size-control-sm controls.

tokens.name: size-lane
tokens.usage: Horizontal pitch between graph lanes.
